definition: an example of something used for testing or study
sentence: The doctor asked for a blood {specimen} for the test.
translation: Врач попросил образец крови для анализа.

definition: a grey powder mixed with water and sand that becomes hard like stone
sentence: The {cement} has to dry for a day before you walk on it.
translation: Цемент должен сохнуть сутки, прежде чем по нему ходить.

definition: the act of leaving your job on purpose, or quiet acceptance
sentence: She handed in her {resignation} the day after the bonus.
translation: Она подала заявление об уходе на следующий день после премии.

definition: the distance from one side of something to the other
sentence: Measure the {width} of the door before you buy the fridge.
translation: Измерь ширину двери, прежде чем покупать холодильник.

definition: a thin white layer of ice that forms when it is very cold
sentence: There was {frost} on the car windows this morning.
translation: Утром окна машины покрылись инеем.

definition: to build or put up something, in formal language
sentence: They {erected} a huge tent for the wedding in two hours.
translation: Они за два часа поставили огромный шатёр для свадьбы.

definition: a serious promise
sentence: He made a {vow} never to drink again after that party.
translation: После той вечеринки он поклялся больше не пить.

definition: the part of a car that you press with your foot to change gear
sentence: I burned the {clutch} while learning to drive.
translation: Я сжёг сцепление, пока учился водить.

definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird's body
sentence: The pillow is full of {feathers} and very soft.
translation: Подушка набита перьями и очень мягкая.

definition: a unit for measuring electrical power
sentence: A sixty {watt} bulb is too dark for the kitchen.
translation: Лампочка на шестьдесят ватт слишком тусклая для кухни.

definition: a statement that someone has done something wrong
sentence: The {accusation} that I took his pen was ridiculous.
translation: Обвинение в том, что я взял его ручку, было смешным.

definition: the part of a computer that does the calculations
sentence: The new phone has a faster {processor} and a better camera.
translation: У нового телефона быстрее процессор и лучше камера.

definition: to give someone the power or confidence to do something
sentence: Learning to drive {empowered} her to find a better job.
translation: Научившись водить, она смогла найти работу получше.

definition: a form of something that is slightly different from others
sentence: This is a cheaper {variant} of the same phone.
translation: Это более дешёвый вариант того же телефона.

definition: one of the curved bones around your chest
sentence: He broke a {rib} falling off the ladder.
translation: Он сломал ребро, упав с лестницы.

definition: to stop a feeling from showing, or to stop something by force
sentence: I {suppressed} a laugh when he fell into the pool.
translation: Я сдержал смех, когда он свалился в бассейн.

definition: to join several things into one stronger whole
sentence: We {consolidated} three small loans into one.
translation: Мы объединили три небольших кредита в один.

definition: a person who will receive money or property when someone dies
sentence: The old man had no {heir}, so the house went to the city.
translation: У старика не было наследников, и дом отошёл городу.

definition: to become smaller or less important
sentence: My interest in the show {diminished} after the second season.
translation: Мой интерес к сериалу угас после второго сезона.

definition: made of many parts or amounts added together
sentence: The {aggregate} score over the two games was four to three.
translation: Общий счёт по итогам двух игр — четыре три.

definition: a statement that you did something wrong or that you feel something private
sentence: I have a {confession}: I ate your chocolate.
translation: У меня признание: я съел твой шоколад.

definition: to die under water because you cannot breathe
sentence: Two people {drowned} in the river last summer.
translation: Прошлым летом в реке утонули два человека.

definition: the process of getting older
sentence: Good sleep slows down {aging}, or so they say.
translation: Хороший сон замедляет старение, так говорят.

definition: real and true, not a copy
sentence: This is an {authentic} Italian pizza, thin and simple.
translation: Это настоящая итальянская пицца, тонкая и простая.

definition: towards the direction behind you
sentence: He stepped {backwards} and fell into the pool.
translation: Он шагнул назад и упал в бассейн.

definition: to deal with a difficult situation without breaking down
sentence: How do you {cope} with two kids and a full-time job?
translation: Как ты справляешься с двумя детьми и работой на полный день?

definition: strange and making you feel afraid or uncomfortable
sentence: That empty house at the end of the street is {creepy}.
translation: Пустой дом в конце улицы наводит жуть.

definition: in a way connected with feelings
sentence: The last episode was {emotionally} hard to watch.
translation: Последнюю серию было эмоционально тяжело смотреть.

definition: the last part of a show, concert or series
sentence: The {finale} of the series answered every question.
translation: Финал сериала ответил на все вопросы.

definition: lack of knowledge about something
sentence: My {ignorance} of local customs cost me a few awkward moments.
translation: Незнание местных обычаев стоило мне нескольких неловких минут.

definition: in the same way, also
sentence: She shook my hand and I did {likewise}.
translation: Она пожала мне руку, и я сделал то же самое.

definition: very beautiful, grand or impressive
sentence: The view from the castle is {magnificent} in the evening.
translation: Вид из замка вечером великолепен.

definition: connected with numbers and the study of them
sentence: Splitting the bill became a {mathematical} problem for six people.
translation: Делить счёт на шестерых стало математической задачей.

definition: the time between now and a later event
sentence: The pizza comes in an hour, in the {meantime} let's set the table.
translation: Пицца будет через час, а пока давай накроем на стол.

definition: in spite of what has just been said
sentence: The flat is small; {nonetheless}, we took it because of the view.
translation: Квартира маленькая, и всё же мы её взяли из-за вида.

definition: activities you do for fun when you are not working
sentence: The park is used for {recreation}: football, picnics, dog walking.
translation: Парк используют для отдыха: футбол, пикники, прогулки с собаками.

definition: the wish to hurt or annoy someone
sentence: He told her secret out of pure {spite}.
translation: Он выдал её секрет из чистой злости.

definition: connected with heat or keeping heat in
sentence: I wear {thermal} socks when I go skiing.
translation: Когда катаюсь на лыжах, надеваю термоноски.

definition: connected with making and selling medicines
sentence: She works for a big {pharmaceutical} company.
translation: Она работает в крупной фармацевтической компании.

definition: the crime of stealing from a person or place, often with force
sentence: There was a {robbery} at the bank on our corner last night.
translation: Вчера ночью ограбили банк на нашем углу.

definition: to accept something you do not like without complaining
sentence: I can {tolerate} noise, but not that smell.
translation: Шум я ещё могу терпеть, но не этот запах.

definition: a small comfortable room in a house, or the home of a wild animal
sentence: Dad watches football in his {den} in the basement.
translation: Папа смотрит футбол в своей берлоге в подвале.

definition: to make bread brown and crisp with heat, or to raise a glass for someone
sentence: {Toast} the bread lightly, I don't like it dark.
translation: Поджарь хлеб слегка, я не люблю тёмный.

definition: a person sent to another country to teach people about a religion
sentence: A {missionary} opened the first school in the valley.
translation: Миссионер открыл первую школу в долине.

definition: secret plans to get power or harm someone
sentence: The office is full of {intrigue} since the new boss came.
translation: С приходом нового начальника в офисе одни интриги.

definition: to officially end a law
sentence: The city {repealed} the ban on dogs in parks.
translation: Город отменил запрет на собак в парках.

definition: to win or be the strongest in the end
sentence: Common sense {prevailed} and we went home before midnight.
translation: Здравый смысл победил, и мы ушли домой до полуночи.

definition: a man who is not married, or a first university degree
sentence: At forty he is still a {bachelor} and happy about it.
translation: В сорок он всё ещё холостяк, и его это устраивает.

definition: to surprise someone very much
sentence: It {amazes} me how fast kids learn languages.
translation: Меня поражает, как быстро дети учат языки.

definition: having no legal power, not valid
sentence: The contract is {void} if one of us doesn't sign it.
translation: Договор недействителен, если кто-то из нас его не подпишет.

definition: to talk too proudly about what you have or can do
sentence: He {boasts} about his new car to anyone who will listen.
translation: Он хвастается новой машиной перед всеми, кто готов слушать.

definition: the smallest unit of a chemical element
sentence: Everything around us is made of {atoms}, even this cake.
translation: Всё вокруг состоит из атомов, даже этот торт.

definition: to bounce back after hitting something, or to recover
sentence: The ball {rebounded} off the post and went in.
translation: Мяч отскочил от штанги и влетел в ворота.

definition: to remove the skin of fruit or vegetables
sentence: Can you {peel} the potatoes while I cut the onions?
translation: Почистишь картошку, пока я режу лук?

definition: a young bear, lion, fox or wolf
sentence: The zoo has a new lion {cub} and everyone wants to see it.
translation: В зоопарке новый львёнок, и все хотят его увидеть.

definition: very clear and unpleasant, with nothing to soften it
sentence: There is a {stark} difference between the two halves of the city.
translation: Между двумя половинами города резкий контраст.

definition: painful, especially because of too much use or an infection
sentence: My legs are {sore} after yesterday's hike.
translation: После вчерашнего похода у меня болят ноги.

definition: a sports match arranged for a particular date, or a thing fixed in a house
sentence: The first {fixture} of the season is against our neighbours.
translation: Первый матч сезона против наших соседей.

definition: a person whose job is to clean rooms or buildings, or a substance for cleaning
sentence: The {cleaner} comes every Tuesday morning.
translation: Уборщица приходит каждый вторник утром.

definition: using the system of measurement based on tens, hundreds and thousands
sentence: The recipe is in {metric} units, so no cups and ounces.
translation: Рецепт в метрических единицах, никаких чашек и унций.

definition: one of the signs ( ) used around extra words, or a group within limits
sentence: Put the price in {brackets} after the name of the dish.
translation: Укажи цену в скобках после названия блюда.

definition: the number 60
sentence: My grandmother is {sixty} and still rides a bike.
translation: Моей бабушке шестьдесят, и она до сих пор ездит на велосипеде.

definition: a period of time between two events, or a break in a show
sentence: We'll get ice cream during the {interval}.
translation: В антракте возьмём мороженое.

definition: a reason for not agreeing with something
sentence: Nobody raised an {objection}, so the plan was accepted.
translation: Никто не возразил, и план приняли.

definition: to tell people about a product or job so they will buy it or apply
sentence: They {advertised} the flat online and got ten calls in an hour.
translation: Они выставили квартиру в интернете и получили десять звонков за час.

definition: a thick piece of material that covers part of a floor
sentence: The cat sleeps on the {rug} in front of the fire.
translation: Кот спит на ковре перед камином.

definition: a substance in the body that makes chemical changes happen
sentence: Some people lack the {enzyme} that breaks down milk.
translation: У некоторых людей нет фермента, который расщепляет молоко.

definition: to watch over work and make sure it is done properly
sentence: She {oversees} three shops in the city centre.
translation: Она курирует три магазина в центре города.

definition: to kill a large number of people violently
sentence: The soldiers {massacred} the whole village in one night.
translation: Солдаты за одну ночь вырезали всю деревню.

definition: a vehicle with four wheels pulled by horses, or a railway car for goods
sentence: The children rode in a {wagon} behind the tractor.
translation: Дети ехали в повозке за трактором.

definition: a sudden illegal taking of power, or a surprising success
sentence: Getting that singer for our small festival was a real {coup}.
translation: Заполучить эту певицу на наш маленький фестиваль было настоящей удачей.

definition: a large black bird with a loud rough voice
sentence: A {raven} sat on the fence and watched us eat.
translation: Ворон сидел на заборе и смотрел, как мы едим.

definition: to hurt someone who trusts you by not being loyal
sentence: He {betrayed} his best friend to get the job.
translation: Он предал лучшего друга ради этой должности.

definition: a strong room in a bank where money and valuable things are kept
sentence: The jewels are kept in a {vault} under the shop.
translation: Драгоценности хранятся в хранилище под магазином.

definition: to get ready for something difficult or unpleasant
sentence: {Brace} yourself, the bill is bigger than we thought.
translation: Приготовься, счёт больше, чем мы думали.

definition: the very cold area around the North Pole
sentence: Polar bears live in the {Arctic}, not with penguins.
translation: Белые медведи живут в Арктике, а не с пингвинами.

definition: a drug made from a plant, smoked or eaten
sentence: {Cannabis} is legal in some countries and banned in others.
translation: Каннабис в одних странах разрешён, в других запрещён.

definition: having a particular number of sides or directions, such as three
sentence: The printer makes three {dimensional} models from plastic.
translation: Принтер печатает трёхмерные модели из пластика.

definition: wanting very much to do or have something
sentence: The kids are {eager} to see the snow.
translation: Дети очень хотят увидеть снег.

definition: the most important part of something that makes it what it is
sentence: In {essence}, the two plans are the same.
translation: По сути, два плана одинаковы.

definition: old things that are useless or of low quality
sentence: The garage is full of {junk} we never use.
translation: Гараж забит хламом, которым мы никогда не пользуемся.

definition: not talking much about your own abilities or success
sentence: He's too {modest} to tell you he won the prize.
translation: Он слишком скромен, чтобы сказать, что выиграл приз.

definition: finding the way from one place to another, by map, stars or satellite
sentence: The {navigation} app sent us down a road that didn't exist.
translation: Навигатор завёл нас на дорогу, которой не существует.

definition: accepting what happens without trying to change it
sentence: Don't be so {passive}, ask for the raise yourself.
translation: Не будь таким пассивным, попроси прибавку сам.

definition: a piece of land with water on three sides
sentence: The old town sits on a {peninsula} between two bays.
translation: Старый город стоит на полуострове между двумя бухтами.

definition: meat from a pig
sentence: I don't eat {pork}, can I have the chicken instead?
translation: Я не ем свинину, можно мне курицу вместо неё?

definition: making money, bringing a profit
sentence: The small bakery became {profitable} in its second year.
translation: Маленькая пекарня стала приносить прибыль на второй год.

definition: quite, fairly, or in a sensible way
sentence: The hotel was {reasonably} clean and very cheap.
translation: Отель был довольно чистый и очень дешёвый.

definition: the part that is left after the rest has been used or taken
sentence: Spend half now and keep the {remainder} for the trip.
translation: Потрать половину сейчас, а остаток оставь на поездку.

definition: as a result of that
sentence: He missed the bus and {thereby} the whole meeting.
translation: Он опоздал на автобус и из-за этого пропустил всю встречу.

definition: relating to a group of people who share one language, land and leader
sentence: The museum shows {tribal} masks from West Africa.
translation: В музее выставлены племенные маски из Западной Африки.

definition: a famous building or place that is easy to recognise
sentence: The tower is the city's best known {landmark}.
translation: Башня — самая известная достопримечательность города.

definition: an opening that lets air, smoke or gas out of a room or machine
sentence: Clean the {vent} above the cooker, it's full of fat.
translation: Почисти вытяжку над плитой, она вся в жире.

definition: guessing about something without knowing the facts
sentence: There's a lot of {speculation} about who will be the next coach.
translation: Много догадок о том, кто станет следующим тренером.

definition: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly and lives in cold places
sentence: The {penguins} at the zoo walk like little waiters.
translation: Пингвины в зоопарке ходят, как маленькие официанты.

definition: a round object shaped like a ball, or an area of activity
sentence: The lamp is a glass {sphere} that glows blue at night.
translation: Лампа — стеклянный шар, который ночью светится синим.

definition: to clean a toilet with a rush of water, or to go red
sentence: Don't forget to {flush} the toilet, please.
translation: Пожалуйста, не забудь смыть в туалете.

definition: a sharp pain from an insect or a plant, or a small wound from it
sentence: The bee {sting} on my hand swelled up for two days.
translation: Укус пчелы на руке распухал два дня.

definition: to walk through water that is not deep
sentence: We {waded} across the river with our shoes in our hands.
translation: Мы перешли реку вброд, держа ботинки в руках.

definition: a hard smooth stone used for buildings and statues, often white
sentence: The bathroom floor is {marble} and freezing in winter.
translation: Пол в ванной мраморный, зимой ледяной.

definition: a written record of events in the order they happened
sentence: Her blog is a {chronicle} of ten years in the village.
translation: Её блог — летопись десяти лет жизни в деревне.

definition: a person or thing with the same job or purpose in another place
sentence: The minister met his French {counterpart} in Paris.
translation: Министр встретился со своим французским коллегой в Париже.

definition: a strong feeling of shock and anger
sentence: There was public {outrage} when the park was sold.
translation: Продажа парка вызвала всеобщее возмущение.

definition: a person who is travelling or who travels often
sentence: A tired {traveler} asked me the way to the station.
translation: Усталый путник спросил у меня дорогу к вокзалу.

definition: a part of the body that reacts to light, heat, taste or chemicals
sentence: Cold {receptors} in the skin tell your brain to shiver.
translation: Рецепторы холода в коже велят мозгу дрожать.

definition: the person who controls a game and makes sure the rules are followed
sentence: The {referee} gave him a red card for the push.
translation: Судья показал ему красную карточку за толчок.

definition: an animal that kills and eats other animals
sentence: Cats are {predators}, even the lazy ones on the sofa.
translation: Кошки — хищники, даже ленивые на диване.

definition: saying that something is not true, or refusing to accept it
sentence: His {denial} didn't help, the video showed everything.
translation: Его отрицание не помогло, на видео было видно всё.

definition: to come out of an egg, or to make a secret plan
sentence: The chicks {hatched} on the first warm day of spring.
translation: Цыплята вылупились в первый тёплый день весны.

definition: a game where people buy tickets with numbers and some win money
sentence: He won two hundred euros in the {lottery} and spent it on dinner.
translation: Он выиграл в лотерею двести евро и потратил их на ужин.

definition: to go away all at once so nobody can see it any more
sentence: My keys {vanished} somewhere between the car and the door.
translation: Мои ключи куда-то пропали между машиной и дверью.

definition: the main church of a city or area, usually very large
sentence: The {cathedral} took two hundred years to build.
translation: Собор строили двести лет.

definition: the act of getting rid of something you do not need
sentence: The {disposal} of old batteries is free at the supermarket.
translation: Утилизация старых батареек в супермаркете бесплатна.

definition: a very senior officer in the navy
sentence: The {admiral} spent more time in offices than at sea.
translation: Адмирал проводил больше времени в кабинетах, чем в море.

definition: a very small part of an atom with a negative electric charge
sentence: Electricity is just {electrons} moving through a wire.
translation: Электричество — это просто электроны, бегущие по проводу.

definition: a large special meal for many people
sentence: The wedding {feast} went on until four in the morning.
translation: Свадебный пир продолжался до четырёх утра.

definition: a person who works in a profession, especially medicine or law
sentence: See a general {practitioner} first, then a specialist.
translation: Сначала сходи к терапевту, потом к специалисту.

definition: a player in football whose job is to score goals
sentence: Our {striker} missed three easy chances in the first half.
translation: Наш нападающий в первом тайме упустил три верных шанса.

definition: a soft solid that melts when warm, used for candles and shine
sentence: The candle {wax} dripped all over the tablecloth.
translation: Воск со свечи накапал на всю скатерть.

definition: a flat area outside a house or cafe where you can sit
sentence: We had breakfast on the {terrace} with a view of the sea.
translation: Мы завтракали на террасе с видом на море.

definition: a person who attacks a place suddenly to steal or destroy
sentence: {Raiders} broke into the warehouse and took the laptops.
translation: Налётчики вломились на склад и забрали ноутбуки.

definition: a sign that something is about to happen, or a messenger in the past
sentence: The first warm day is the {herald} of spring here.
translation: Первый тёплый день здесь — предвестник весны.

definition: something difficult that you have done successfully
sentence: Finishing the course while working was a real {accomplishment}.
translation: Закончить курс, не бросая работу, — настоящее достижение.

definition: to hit your foot on something and almost fall
sentence: I {stumbled} on the step and spilled the coffee.
translation: Я споткнулся о ступеньку и пролил кофе.

definition: an arm or a leg
sentence: He lost a {limb} in the accident but still swims every day.
translation: В аварии он потерял руку, но всё равно плавает каждый день.

definition: a large group of soldiers led by a colonel
sentence: My grandfather's {regiment} was sent to the coast in 1944.
translation: Полк моего деда отправили на побережье в 1944 году.

definition: the person who had a job before the one who has it now
sentence: My {predecessor} left the office in a terrible mess.
translation: Мой предшественник оставил в кабинете страшный беспорядок.

definition: the state of being forced to live away from your own country
sentence: The writer spent twenty years in {exile} in Paris.
translation: Писатель провёл двадцать лет в изгнании в Париже.

definition: a tendency to become angry quickly
sentence: He has a {temper}, so don't mention the match.
translation: Он вспыльчивый, так что про матч не напоминай.

definition: to collect or gather more and more over time
sentence: Dust {accumulates} on the shelves faster than I can clean.
translation: Пыль на полках собирается быстрее, чем я успеваю убирать.

definition: a race in which team members run one after another
sentence: Our school won the four by one hundred {relay}.
translation: Наша школа выиграла эстафету четыре по сто.

definition: to form an idea or plan in your mind, or to become pregnant
sentence: The whole festival was {conceived} in a pub on a rainy night.
translation: Весь фестиваль был задуман в пабе дождливым вечером.

definition: in a way that fits the situation, or as a result
sentence: The tickets sold out, and {accordingly} they added a second show.
translation: Билеты распродали, и соответственно добавили второй показ.

definition: connected with beauty and the way things look
sentence: The chair is strong, but from an {aesthetic} point of view it's ugly.
translation: Стул крепкий, но с эстетической точки зрения уродливый.

definition: an imaginary line through the middle of something that turns
sentence: The Earth turns on its {axis} once a day.
translation: Земля делает оборот вокруг своей оси раз в сутки.

definition: very strange and unusual
sentence: He wore a {bizarre} hat with feathers to the meeting.
translation: Он пришёл на встречу в нелепой шляпе с перьями.

definition: sending out programmes on radio or television
sentence: She works in {broadcasting}, mostly on morning radio.
translation: Она работает на телерадиовещании, в основном на утреннем радио.

definition: relating to a large land mass, especially mainland Europe
sentence: A {continental} breakfast means coffee and a croissant, nothing hot.
translation: Континентальный завтрак — это кофе и круассан, ничего горячего.

definition: on purpose, not by accident
sentence: She {deliberately} left her phone at home for the weekend.
translation: Она нарочно оставила телефон дома на выходные.

definition: calm serious behaviour that makes people respect you
sentence: She lost the match but left the court with {dignity}.
translation: Она проиграла матч, но ушла с корта с достоинством.

definition: a strong feeling of interest and excitement about something
sentence: I lost my {enthusiasm} for the gym after two weeks.
translation: Через две недели мой запал к спортзалу пропал.

definition: the ability to change or bend easily when needed
sentence: Working from home gives me {flexibility} with the kids.
translation: Работа из дома даёт мне гибкость с детьми.

definition: a cold box in the kitchen where food is kept fresh
sentence: There's nothing in the {fridge} except mustard.
translation: В холодильнике ничего нет, кроме горчицы.

definition: the joining of two different things into one, such as styles of cooking
sentence: The restaurant does Japanese and Mexican {fusion}.
translation: В ресторане смешивают японскую и мексиканскую кухню.

definition: the state of being alone and away from other people
sentence: Living on the island, she felt the {isolation} in winter.
translation: Живя на острове, зимой она чувствовала оторванность от людей.

definition: machines, especially large ones, as a group
sentence: The farm sold its old {machinery} and bought one big tractor.
translation: Ферма продала старую технику и купила один большой трактор.

definition: a heavy silver metal that is liquid at room temperature
sentence: Old thermometers have {mercury} inside, so don't break them.
translation: В старых градусниках ртуть, так что не разбивай их.

definition: used to give exact details about what you have just said
sentence: Two people were late, {namely} you and me.
translation: Опоздали двое, а именно ты и я.

definition: waiting to be decided or finished
sentence: Your application is still {pending}, check again next week.
translation: Ваша заявка пока на рассмотрении, проверьте на следующей неделе.

definition: a very valuable silver-white metal
sentence: Her ring is {platinum}, which costs more than gold.
translation: Её кольцо из платины, а она дороже золота.

definition: a flat board on a wall or in a cupboard for putting things on
sentence: The books are on the top {shelf}, you'll need a chair.
translation: Книги на верхней полке, тебе понадобится стул.

definition: completely, totally
sentence: I was {utterly} exhausted after the move.
translation: После переезда я был совершенно вымотан.

definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
sentence: Let's take a {cab}, it's too late for the bus.
translation: Давай возьмём такси, для автобуса уже поздно.

definition: to make someone laugh or enjoy themselves
sentence: The puppy {amused} the kids for the whole afternoon.
translation: Щенок развлекал детей весь день.

definition: any of the numbers from 0 to 9
sentence: Your code is the last four {digits} of your phone number.
translation: Твой код — последние четыре цифры номера телефона.

definition: a book used for studying a subject at school or university
sentence: The {textbook} costs more than the course itself.
translation: Учебник стоит дороже самого курса.

definition: a tall machine for lifting heavy things, or a tall bird with long legs
sentence: A {crane} lifted the piano through the fourth-floor window.
translation: Кран поднял пианино через окно четвёртого этажа.

definition: a large lake, often man-made, where water is stored
sentence: The town gets its water from a {reservoir} in the hills.
translation: Город получает воду из водохранилища в холмах.

definition: a hand with the fingers closed tightly
sentence: He banged his {fist} on the table and everyone went quiet.
translation: Он стукнул кулаком по столу, и все замолчали.

definition: a soft green or black growth on old food or wet walls
sentence: There's {mold} on the bread, throw it away.
translation: На хлебе плесень, выброси его.

definition: with things or people very close together, thick
sentence: The forest is so {dense} that you can't see the sky.
translation: Лес такой густой, что неба не видно.

definition: a person from another country
sentence: As a {foreigner} I needed a special card to rent the flat.
translation: Как иностранцу мне понадобилась специальная карта, чтобы снять квартиру.

definition: something that you must have, or the fact of being needed
sentence: A good coat is a {necessity} here, not a luxury.
translation: Хорошее пальто здесь необходимость, а не роскошь.

definition: a dangerous action done to entertain people, especially in a film
sentence: He did his own {stunts} in the film, including the jump from the bridge.
translation: Он сам выполнял трюки в фильме, включая прыжок с моста.

definition: to provide food and drink for an event, or to give what is needed
sentence: A local company {catered} the wedding for eighty guests.
translation: Местная компания обслуживала свадьбу на восемьдесят гостей.

definition: an area of water near land where ships are safe
sentence: The fishing boats come back to the {harbour} at dawn.
translation: Рыбацкие лодки возвращаются в гавань на рассвете.

definition: a person whose job is to carry bags at a hotel or station
sentence: The {porter} took our bags up while we checked in.
translation: Носильщик отнёс наши сумки наверх, пока мы заселялись.

definition: a person kept in a prison
sentence: The {inmate} was allowed one phone call a week.
translation: Заключённому разрешали один телефонный звонок в неделю.

definition: a small round fruit that grows in bunches and is used for wine
sentence: She washed a bunch of green {grapes} for the children.
translation: Она помыла гроздь зелёного винограда для детей.

definition: a person who gives money or support to an artist or a cause
sentence: A rich {patron} paid for the painter's studio.
translation: Богатый покровитель оплатил мастерскую художника.

definition: a flat shape with three straight sides and three corners
sentence: Fold the paper into a {triangle} and cut along the edge.
translation: Сложи бумагу треугольником и отрежь по краю.

definition: a plant whose leaves are used to add taste to food or as medicine
sentence: Add a fresh {herb} like basil just before you serve the soup.
translation: Добавь свежую траву, например базилик, прямо перед подачей супа.

definition: a plant with a strong fresh taste, used in sweets and drinks
sentence: He put a leaf of {mint} on top of the ice cream.
translation: Он положил листик мяты поверх мороженого.

definition: a soft sweet that you chew but do not swallow
sentence: Please throw your {gum} away before the lesson starts.
translation: Пожалуйста, выбрось жвачку до начала урока.

definition: a plant with large white or coloured flowers shaped like a bell
sentence: A white {lily} stood in a vase by the window.
translation: Белая лилия стояла в вазе у окна.

definition: meat or vegetables cooked in a hot sauce with strong spices
sentence: We ordered a chicken {curry} with rice and bread.
translation: Мы заказали карри с курицей, рисом и хлебом.

definition: a line in a text that names the source of an idea or words
sentence: Every {citation} in your essay must match the list at the end.
translation: Каждая ссылка в твоём эссе должна совпадать со списком в конце.

definition: to announce something important in public
sentence: The king stood up to {proclaim} the end of the war.
translation: Король встал, чтобы провозгласить конец войны.

definition: to follow a person or animal quietly in order to catch or watch them
sentence: The cat began to {stalk} the bird across the lawn.
translation: Кошка стала подкрадываться к птице через газон.

definition: a vote in which all the people decide on one question
sentence: The country held a {referendum} on joining the union.
translation: Страна провела референдум о вступлении в союз.

definition: official permission to do something or to enter a place
sentence: You need security {clearance} to enter the lab.
translation: Вам нужен допуск, чтобы войти в лабораторию.

definition: a person who carries a message or a package to someone
sentence: A {messenger} brought the letter to the palace at night.
translation: Гонец принёс письмо во дворец ночью.

definition: the player in American football who leads the attack and throws the ball
sentence: The {quarterback} threw the ball just before he was hit.
translation: Квотербек бросил мяч за мгновение до того, как его сбили.

definition: the line of bones down the middle of your back
sentence: He hurt his {spine} when he fell off the ladder.
translation: Он повредил позвоночник, когда упал с лестницы.

definition: a long narrow passage in a building with doors on each side
sentence: Her office is at the end of the {corridor} on the left.
translation: Её кабинет в конце коридора слева.

definition: a building where Muslims go to pray
sentence: The old {mosque} has a tall white tower.
translation: У старой мечети высокая белая башня.

definition: old and valuable because of its age and quality
sentence: She bought an {antique} clock at the market.
translation: Она купила старинные часы на рынке.

definition: to give money or something good to make up for a loss
sentence: The airline {compensated} us for the lost luggage.
translation: Авиакомпания возместила нам потерянный багаж.

definition: a place where two ends of rope or string are tied together
sentence: Tie a tight {knot} so the boat does not drift away.
translation: Завяжи крепкий узел, чтобы лодку не унесло.

definition: a narrow way for walking, or a series of steps towards a goal
sentence: A stone {pathway} leads from the gate to the house.
translation: Каменная дорожка ведёт от ворот к дому.

definition: the amount of food, drink or people taken in during a period
sentence: The doctor told him to reduce his daily salt {intake}.
translation: Врач велел ему сократить ежедневное потребление соли.

definition: to think or believe something, often a guess
sentence: I {reckon} the train will be late again.
translation: Думаю, поезд снова опоздает.

definition: a light silver metal used for cans, foil and planes
sentence: The bike frame is made of {aluminum}, so it weighs very little.
translation: Рама велосипеда сделана из алюминия, поэтому она очень лёгкая.

definition: the ability to produce new and interesting ideas or things
sentence: Her {creativity} shows in every dish she cooks.
translation: Её творческий подход виден в каждом блюде, которое она готовит.

definition: easy to break or damage, needing careful handling
sentence: Those glasses are {delicate}, so wash them by hand.
translation: Эти бокалы хрупкие, так что мой их вручную.

definition: in an official way, or following fixed rules of behaviour
sentence: The deal was {formally} signed at a ceremony in May.
translation: Сделка была официально подписана на церемонии в мае.

definition: repeated behaviour that upsets or frightens a person who does not want it
sentence: She reported the {harassment} to the police and her manager.
translation: Она сообщила о домогательствах в полицию и своему руководителю.

definition: a strong drink with alcohol, such as whisky
sentence: The shop is not allowed to sell {liquor} after ten.
translation: Магазину нельзя продавать крепкий алкоголь после десяти.

definition: used to point out an important example of what you mean
sentence: Many stars came, {notably} the two actors from the film.
translation: Пришло много звёзд, особенно два актёра из фильма.

definition: the quality of being exact and accurate
sentence: The parts are cut with great {precision} by a laser.
translation: Детали вырезаются лазером с большой точностью.

definition: the act of keeping something safe from harm or change
sentence: The group works for the {preservation} of old forests.
translation: Группа работает над сохранением старых лесов.

definition: not in public, or paid for by a person rather than the state
sentence: He told me {privately} that he planned to leave.
translation: Он сказал мне наедине, что собирается уйти.

definition: a large fish with pink flesh that is popular as food
sentence: We had grilled {salmon} with lemon for dinner.
translation: На ужин у нас был лосось на гриле с лимоном.

definition: without other people knowing
sentence: She had {secretly} been learning to drive for months.
translation: Она несколько месяцев тайно училась водить.

definition: used to stress how large or strong something is
sentence: The {sheer} size of the hall took my breath away.
translation: Один только размер зала захватил у меня дух.

definition: for one particular purpose or person
sentence: The cake was made {specially} for her birthday.
translation: Торт был сделан специально ко дню её рождения.

definition: based on ideas rather than on practice or experience
sentence: The risk is only {theoretical}; nobody has seen it happen.
translation: Риск только теоретический: никто не видел, чтобы это случилось.

definition: clear enough to see through, or easy to understand and check
sentence: The box has a {transparent} lid so you can see inside.
translation: У коробки прозрачная крышка, так что видно, что внутри.

definition: the good part of a situation that also has bad parts
sentence: The {upside} of the long trip was the view from the train.
translation: Плюсом долгой поездки был вид из поезда.

definition: done by choice and not because you must, often without pay
sentence: Joining the clean-up was {voluntary}, but almost everyone came.
translation: Участие в уборке было добровольным, но пришли почти все.

definition: a plant whose seeds are ground to make bread
sentence: Fields of golden {wheat} stretched to the hills.
translation: Поля золотой пшеницы тянулись до холмов.

definition: to show or tell people about something new for the first time
sentence: The company will {unveil} its new phone next week.
translation: Компания представит свой новый телефон на следующей неделе.

definition: a deep red precious stone used in jewellery
sentence: Her ring had a small {ruby} set in gold.
translation: В её кольце был маленький рубин в золоте.

definition: to make someone lose hope or stop wanting to do something
sentence: Bad weather did not {discourage} the fans from coming.
translation: Плохая погода не отбила у болельщиков желание прийти.

definition: to laugh at someone or make jokes about them, kindly or not
sentence: Her brothers used to {tease} her about her curly hair.
translation: Братья дразнили её из-за кудрявых волос.

definition: a deep narrow valley with steep rock sides, often with a river
sentence: We stood at the edge and looked down into the {canyon}.
translation: Мы стояли на краю и смотрели вниз, в каньон.

definition: a flat paper cover for sending a letter
sentence: She sealed the {envelope} and wrote the address on it.
translation: Она запечатала конверт и написала на нём адрес.

definition: the sound or the drops made when something hits water
sentence: The stone hit the pond with a loud {splash}.
translation: Камень упал в пруд с громким всплеском.

definition: to find out something that was hidden or secret
sentence: Reporters worked for months to {uncover} the truth.
translation: Журналисты месяцами работали, чтобы раскрыть правду.

definition: a single living thing, such as a plant, animal or bacterium
sentence: Every {organism} in the pond depends on the sunlight.
translation: Каждый организм в пруду зависит от солнечного света.

definition: an exact copy of a plant, animal or thing
sentence: The sheep was a {clone} of its mother.
translation: Овца была клоном своей матери.

definition: a long hard walk, often through hills or wild country
sentence: The {trek} to the camp took us two whole days.
translation: Поход до лагеря занял у нас целых два дня.

definition: to cut wood or stone into a shape, or to cut cooked meat
sentence: He learned to {carve} small birds out of wood.
translation: Он научился вырезать маленьких птиц из дерева.

definition: something made of several different parts or materials
sentence: The new wing is a {composite} of carbon and glass.
translation: Новое крыло — композит из углерода и стекла.

definition: a person whose job is to teach or train people
sentence: As an {educator}, she believes every child can learn.
translation: Как педагог, она верит, что каждый ребёнок может учиться.

definition: an animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal
sentence: The owl waits in the dark for its {prey}.
translation: Сова ждёт в темноте свою добычу.

definition: to cover part of the same space or time as something else
sentence: Our shifts {overlap} by an hour, so we can talk then.
translation: Наши смены пересекаются на час, так что мы можем тогда поговорить.

definition: a long loud deep sound made by a lion, engine or crowd
sentence: The {roar} of the engines filled the whole stadium.
translation: Рёв моторов заполнил весь стадион.

definition: a short performance to show you are good enough for a role
sentence: She has an {audition} for the school play on Friday.
translation: У неё в пятницу прослушивание на школьный спектакль.

definition: having an empty space inside
sentence: The old tree was {hollow}, and birds lived inside it.
translation: Старое дерево было полым, и внутри жили птицы.

definition: a load of goods sent together to a buyer
sentence: The first {shipment} of books arrives on Tuesday.
translation: Первая партия книг прибывает во вторник.

definition: a person who eats no meat, fish, eggs or milk products
sentence: As a {vegan}, she checks every label for milk and eggs.
translation: Как веган, она проверяет каждую этикетку на молоко и яйца.

definition: a small cupboard with a lock where you keep your things
sentence: Leave your bag in a {locker} before you enter the pool.
translation: Оставь сумку в шкафчике, прежде чем войти в бассейн.

definition: a small bag for money, or a woman's handbag
sentence: She took a coin out of her {purse} and gave it to the boy.
translation: Она достала монету из кошелька и дала мальчику.

definition: a structure that sends water up into the air for decoration
sentence: Children were throwing coins into the {fountain} in the square.
translation: Дети бросали монеты в фонтан на площади.

definition: a large machine in which nuclear energy is produced
sentence: The {reactor} was shut down for safety checks.
translation: Реактор остановили для проверки безопасности.

definition: a list of names and numbers, or a folder holding computer files
sentence: Save the photos in a new {directory} on the drive.
translation: Сохрани фотографии в новой папке на диске.

definition: an unfair situation in which some people have more than others
sentence: The report shows growing {inequality} between rich and poor regions.
translation: Отчёт показывает растущее неравенство между богатыми и бедными регионами.

definition: to make something as small as possible
sentence: Wear a helmet to {minimize} the risk of head injury.
translation: Надевай шлем, чтобы свести к минимуму риск травмы головы.

definition: the top part of your leg, between your hip and knee
sentence: He pulled a muscle in his {thigh} during the race.
translation: Он потянул мышцу бедра во время забега.

definition: two things happening at the same time by chance
sentence: By pure {coincidence}, we were on the same flight.
translation: По чистой случайности мы оказались на одном рейсе.

definition: a small piece of paper with glue on the back and a picture or words
sentence: The child put a star {sticker} on every page.
translation: Ребёнок наклеил наклейку со звездой на каждую страницу.

definition: to join pieces of cloth together using a needle and thread
sentence: My grandmother taught me to {sew} on a button.
translation: Бабушка научила меня пришивать пуговицу.

definition: to join separate parts or groups into one
sentence: The new law aims to {unify} the rules across all regions.
translation: Новый закон призван объединить правила во всех регионах.

definition: very serious, sudden and strong, or very sharp
sentence: There is an {acute} shortage of nurses in rural areas.
translation: В сельских районах острая нехватка медсестёр.

definition: the part of your face below your mouth
sentence: He rubbed his {chin} while he thought about the question.
translation: Он потирал подбородок, обдумывая вопрос.

definition: relating to a town or city and the people who live in it
sentence: Voting is a basic {civic} duty in a democracy.
translation: Голосование — основная гражданская обязанность в демократии.

definition: by a large amount or degree
sentence: Prices have risen {considerably} since last year.
translation: Цены значительно выросли с прошлого года.

definition: simple and rough, or rude; also oil in its natural state
sentence: He drew a {crude} map of the village on a napkin.
translation: Он нарисовал грубую карту деревни на салфетке.

definition: easy to recognise because it is different from others
sentence: The singer has a {distinctive} deep voice.
translation: У певицы характерный низкий голос.

definition: strongly and without moving or changing your mind
sentence: She held the rope {firmly} with both hands.
translation: Она крепко держала верёвку обеими руками.

definition: a fine white powder made from grain, used to make bread
sentence: Mix the {flour} with the eggs and a little milk.
translation: Смешай муку с яйцами и небольшим количеством молока.

definition: not going straight to the point or by the shortest way
sentence: We took an {indirect} route to avoid the traffic.
translation: Мы поехали объездным путём, чтобы избежать пробок.

definition: relating to large official organisations such as schools or banks
sentence: The painting hung in a cold {institutional} hall.
translation: Картина висела в холодном казённом зале.

definition: meant to be used for a short time until the final thing is ready
sentence: An {interim} manager will run the team until June.
translation: Временный менеджер будет руководить командой до июня.

definition: kind, warm and caring in nature
sentence: A {kindly} old man showed us the way to the station.
translation: Добрый старик показал нам дорогу к вокзалу.

definition: the quality of being friendly and helpful to others
sentence: Thank you for your {kindness} during my illness.
translation: Спасибо за вашу доброту во время моей болезни.

definition: the great size or importance of something
sentence: We did not understand the {magnitude} of the problem.
translation: Мы не понимали масштаба проблемы.

definition: used when you take one number away from another
sentence: Ten {minus} three leaves seven, so you have seven left.
translation: Десять минус три будет семь.

definition: attention from newspapers and television, or work to get it
sentence: The scandal brought the band a lot of bad {publicity}.
translation: Скандал принёс группе много плохой огласки.

definition: the process of finding and taking on new people for a job
sentence: The army has started a big {recruitment} drive this year.
translation: Армия начала в этом году большую кампанию по набору.

definition: a chemical element used to make computer chips
sentence: Most computer chips are made from {silicon}.
translation: Большинство компьютерных чипов делают из кремния.

definition: an old system for sending messages along wires using signals
sentence: News of the victory arrived by {telegraph} the same night.
translation: Новость о победе пришла по телеграфу той же ночью.

definition: a strong plastic, or a record made of it for playing music
sentence: He still buys music on {vinyl} and plays it on weekends.
translation: Он всё ещё покупает музыку на виниле и слушает по выходным.

definition: a person who kills another person on purpose
sentence: The police caught the {murderer} two days after the crime.
translation: Полиция поймала убийцу через два дня после преступления.

translation: Он ударился локтем о дверь, и локоть болел целый час.

definition: a change made to improve a text, or studying again before an exam
sentence: The report needs one more {revision} before we send it.
translation: Отчёту нужна ещё одна правка, прежде чем мы его отправим.

definition: a vehicle pulled by horses, or one of the parts of a train
sentence: We sat in the last {carriage} of the train, far from the engine.
translation: Мы сидели в последнем вагоне поезда, далеко от локомотива.

definition: a person who studies the deepest questions about life, truth and thought
sentence: The Greek {philosopher} taught that the soul never dies.
translation: Греческий философ учил, что душа никогда не умирает.

definition: a series of musical notes that make a tune
sentence: The {melody} of the song stayed in my head all day.
translation: Мелодия песни весь день крутилась у меня в голове.

definition: a plant-like food with a round top and a stem, some kinds are poisonous
sentence: We picked every {mushroom} we could find in the forest.
translation: Мы собрали в лесу все грибы, какие смогли найти.

definition: a sudden attack of illness that makes the body shake, or taking something by force
sentence: The boy had a {seizure} and the teacher called an ambulance.
translation: У мальчика случился припадок, и учитель вызвал скорую.

definition: violent action by people against their rulers
sentence: The {rebellion} against the king lasted two years.
translation: Восстание против короля длилось два года.

definition: a meeting of people who have not seen each other for a long time
sentence: Our school {reunion} is in May, are you going?
translation: Встреча выпускников в мае, ты идёшь?

definition: an arrangement to have a room, seat or table kept for you
sentence: I made a {booking} for two at the Italian place.
translation: Я забронировал столик на двоих в итальянском ресторане.

definition: money given regularly to someone, or an amount allowed
sentence: The children get a weekly {allowance} for small expenses.
translation: Дети получают еженедельные карманные деньги на мелкие расходы.

definition: a very large board outside on which advertisements are shown
sentence: A huge {billboard} by the road showed the new car.
translation: Огромный рекламный щит у дороги показывал новую машину.

definition: the holy writings of a religion
sentence: The priest read from {scripture} at the start of the service.
translation: В начале службы священник прочитал отрывок из Писания.

definition: to put a drug or liquid into the body with a needle
sentence: The nurse will {inject} the vaccine into your upper arm.
translation: Медсестра введёт вакцину в верхнюю часть руки.

definition: a line of people or cars waiting for something
sentence: There was a long {queue} outside the bakery on Sunday morning.
translation: В воскресенье утром у пекарни была длинная очередь.

definition: a place where a battle is or was fought
sentence: The old {battlefield} is now a quiet green park.
translation: Старое поле боя теперь тихий зелёный парк.

definition: to support a decision or law and keep it in force
sentence: The court decided to {uphold} the original ruling.
translation: Суд решил оставить первоначальное решение в силе.

definition: all the living things in an area and how they depend on each other
sentence: The coral reef is a rich {ecosystem} full of fish.
translation: Коралловый риф — богатая экосистема, полная рыбы.

definition: a doctor who treats people's teeth
sentence: I have an appointment with the {dentist} at four.
translation: У меня приём у стоматолога в четыре.

definition: the outer edge of a group, area or activity, or hair cut over the forehead
sentence: The party sits on the {fringe} of national politics.
translation: Партия находится на периферии национальной политики.

definition: a hard yellow-brown material from old tree sap, used in jewellery
sentence: The necklace was made of {amber} from the Baltic coast.
translation: Ожерелье было сделано из янтаря с балтийского побережья.

definition: metal or strong material that protects a body or vehicle in a fight
sentence: The knight's {armor} was so heavy he needed help to mount his horse.
translation: Доспехи рыцаря были такими тяжёлыми, что ему помогали сесть на коня.

definition: a condition that affects how a person communicates and relates to others
sentence: Her son has {autism} and prefers quiet rooms.
translation: У её сына аутизм, и он предпочитает тихие комнаты.

definition: an economic system in which businesses are owned by private people, not the state
sentence: Under {capitalism}, prices are set by buyers and sellers.
translation: При капитализме цены устанавливают покупатели и продавцы.

definition: able to work or exist together without problems
sentence: This printer is not {compatible} with the new laptop.
translation: Этот принтер несовместим с новым ноутбуком.

definition: without stopping or pausing
sentence: The machine has run {continuously} for three days.
translation: Машина работает непрерывно уже три дня.

definition: a situation in which water covers land that is usually dry
sentence: Heavy rain caused {flooding} in the lower part of town.
translation: Сильный дождь вызвал наводнение в нижней части города.

definition: lucky, or having good luck
sentence: We were {fortunate} to find a room on such a busy night.
translation: Нам повезло найти номер в такой загруженный вечер.

definition: used to say that something good happened by luck
sentence: {Fortunately}, nobody was hurt in the crash.
translation: К счастью, в аварии никто не пострадал.

definition: relating to the land, position and features of a place
sentence: The two towns are close, but {geographic} barriers keep them apart.
translation: Два города близки, но географические преграды их разделяют.

definition: useful and easy to use, or near and easy to reach
sentence: A small torch is {handy} when the power goes out.
translation: Маленький фонарик удобен, когда отключают электричество.

definition: extreme and very committed, or very strong and uncompromising
sentence: Only the {hardcore} fans stayed in the rain until the end.
translation: Только самые преданные болельщики остались под дождём до конца.

definition: causing damage or hurt
sentence: Smoking is {harmful} to everyone in the room, not just the smoker.
translation: Курение вредно для всех в комнате, а не только для курящего.

definition: belonging to her
sentence: The red coat is mine and the blue one is {hers}.
translation: Красное пальто моё, а синее — её.

definition: including everyone or everything, with no one left out
sentence: The school tries to be {inclusive} of children with disabilities.
translation: Школа старается быть открытой для детей с инвалидностью.

definition: very foolish behaviour, or serious mental illness
sentence: Driving on that road in the snow would be {madness}.
translation: Ехать по той дороге в снег было бы безумием.

definition: worth remembering because it was special or very good
sentence: The trip to Japan was the most {memorable} holiday of my life.
translation: Поездка в Японию стала самым запоминающимся отпуском в моей жизни.

definition: a card game in which players bet on who has the best cards
sentence: They played {poker} until three in the morning.
translation: Они играли в покер до трёх часов ночи.

definition: light and small enough to be carried easily
sentence: She bought a {portable} speaker for the beach.
translation: Она купила переносную колонку для пляжа.

definition: without any plan or pattern, by chance
sentence: The winners were chosen {randomly} from all the entries.
translation: Победителей выбрали случайным образом из всех заявок.

definition: a person's sexual feelings and which people they are attracted to
sentence: Nobody should be judged because of their {sexuality}.
translation: Никого нельзя осуждать из-за его сексуальности.

definition: a series of people or things that follow one another
sentence: A {succession} of storms hit the coast in March.
translation: В марте на побережье обрушилась череда штормов.

definition: a person who manages a building, a police area or a group of schools
sentence: The {superintendent} fixed the heating in the whole building.
translation: Управляющий починил отопление во всём доме.

definition: planned to gain an advantage in a particular situation
sentence: The coach made a {tactical} change at half time.
translation: В перерыве тренер сделал тактическую замену.

definition: after that time
sentence: She moved to Rome in 1990 and lived there {thereafter}.
translation: В 1990 году она переехала в Рим и с тех пор жила там.

definition: done with great care, looking at every small part
sentence: The mechanic did a {thorough} check of the brakes.
translation: Механик тщательно проверил тормоза.

definition: teaching, or the money paid for being taught
sentence: The {tuition} at the private school is ten thousand a year.
translation: Плата за обучение в частной школе — десять тысяч в год.

definition: in large amounts and at low prices, to shops rather than to the public
sentence: The farm sells its apples {wholesale} to supermarkets.
translation: Ферма продаёт яблоки оптом супермаркетам.

definition: to make a process work by machines instead of people
sentence: The factory plans to {automate} the packing line next year.
translation: Фабрика планирует автоматизировать линию упаковки в следующем году.

definition: the outer edge of something round, like a wheel or a cup
sentence: There was lipstick on the {rim} of the glass.
translation: На ободке стакана была помада.

definition: a program used to look at pages on the internet
sentence: Open the link in a different {browser} if the page does not load.
translation: Открой ссылку в другом браузере, если страница не загружается.

definition: an area of very wet soft land, often with trees
sentence: Mosquitoes bred in the {swamp} behind the village.
translation: Комары плодились в болоте за деревней.

definition: to make something difficult to see or understand
sentence: Thick fog began to {obscure} the lights of the harbour.
translation: Густой туман начал скрывать огни гавани.

definition: a solid shape with six equal square sides
sentence: Put an ice {cube} in each glass before you pour the juice.
translation: Положи кубик льда в каждый стакан, прежде чем наливать сок.

definition: a dark grey rock that splits into thin flat pieces, used for roofs
sentence: The old house has a roof of grey {slate}.
translation: У старого дома крыша из серого сланца.

definition: a bird that hunts other animals and can fly very fast
sentence: A {falcon} dropped from the sky and caught the pigeon.
translation: Сокол упал с неба и схватил голубя.

definition: a safe place, especially for animals or for people in danger
sentence: The island is a {sanctuary} for birds that nest on the cliffs.
translation: Остров — заповедник для птиц, гнездящихся на скалах.

definition: a ship that can travel under the water
sentence: The {submarine} stayed under the ice for three weeks.
translation: Подводная лодка три недели находилась подо льдом.

definition: a large strong fire
sentence: Firefighters fought the {blaze} in the warehouse all night.
translation: Пожарные всю ночь боролись с пожаром на складе.

definition: a large black bird with a loud rough cry
sentence: A {crow} sat on the fence and watched us eat.
translation: Ворона сидела на заборе и смотрела, как мы едим.

definition: coming after nine others in a series
sentence: Today is my {tenth} day without coffee.
translation: Сегодня мой десятый день без кофе.

definition: a person who has religious faith, or who is sure that something is good
sentence: He is a strong {believer} in early starts and cold showers.
translation: Он твёрдо верит в ранний подъём и холодный душ.

definition: a computer program that does simple tasks automatically, often on the internet
sentence: A {bot} answers the first questions on the support chat.
translation: Бот отвечает на первые вопросы в чате поддержки.

definition: a shape with a round base and a point at the top
sentence: The road was closed off with an orange traffic {cone}.
translation: Дорога была перекрыта оранжевым дорожным конусом.

definition: to play a recording or a game again
sentence: Let's {replay} the last ten seconds and see who touched the ball.
translation: Давай пересмотрим последние десять секунд и увидим, кто коснулся мяча.

definition: a rabbit, especially in children's language
sentence: The little girl held the {bunny} gently in her arms.
translation: Маленькая девочка нежно держала кролика на руках.

definition: to move an event to a later time
sentence: Let's {postpone} the picnic until the rain stops.
translation: Давай отложим пикник, пока не закончится дождь.

definition: a small paper or plastic container that goods are sold in
sentence: He opened a {packet} of crisps and offered me one.
translation: Он открыл пакетик чипсов и предложил мне.

definition: to say words for someone to write down, or to order what must happen
sentence: The manager began to {dictate} a letter to his assistant.
translation: Менеджер начал диктовать письмо своему помощнику.

definition: a lesson or guide that teaches how to do something step by step
sentence: I watched a {tutorial} on how to fix a bicycle tyre.
translation: Я посмотрел обучающее видео о том, как починить велосипедную шину.

definition: to keep someone or something inside a limited space or area
sentence: The dog is {confined} to the kitchen while the guests are here.
translation: Пока гости здесь, собака заперта на кухне.

definition: a voter in the area a politician speaks for, or one part of a whole
sentence: The senator met every {constituent} who came to her office.
translation: Сенатор встретилась с каждым избирателем, пришедшим в её офис.

definition: a group of ordinary people trained as soldiers but not part of the regular army
sentence: The {militia} guarded the village at night.
translation: Ополчение охраняло деревню по ночам.

definition: a man on the day he gets married
sentence: The {groom} waited nervously at the front of the church.
translation: Жених нервно ждал у алтаря церкви.

definition: a young child who has just learned to walk
sentence: The {toddler} ran across the room and fell into her father's arms.
translation: Малышка пробежала через комнату и упала в объятия отца.

definition: to refuse to buy or take part in something as a protest
sentence: Fans decided to {boycott} the match over the high ticket prices.
translation: Болельщики решили бойкотировать матч из-за высоких цен на билеты.

definition: a large bird with a long neck that lives near water
sentence: A {goose} hissed at us when we walked past the pond.
translation: Гусь зашипел на нас, когда мы проходили мимо пруда.

definition: an officer of high rank, or an official who keeps order at an event
sentence: A {marshal} waved the runners onto the right road.
translation: Распорядитель направил бегунов на нужную дорогу.

definition: a large group of soldiers, or a very large number of people
sentence: A {legion} of fans followed the band from city to city.
translation: Легион поклонников следовал за группой из города в город.

definition: the speed at which something moves in a particular direction
sentence: The rocket reached a {velocity} of eight kilometres a second.
translation: Ракета достигла скорости восемь километров в секунду.

definition: to make someone a little angry, or to make skin sore
sentence: Loud chewing can {irritate} the people around you.
translation: Громкое чавканье может раздражать окружающих.

definition: the first screen a computer shows, or a computer that stays on a desk
sentence: Save the file to the {desktop} so you can find it quickly.
translation: Сохрани файл на рабочий стол, чтобы быстро его найти.

definition: money paid by a government to keep prices low or support an activity
sentence: Farmers receive a {subsidy} for every hectare of wheat.
translation: Фермеры получают субсидию за каждый гектар пшеницы.

definition: to stop something from continuing normally
sentence: A power cut will {disrupt} the whole production line.
translation: Отключение электричества нарушит работу всей производственной линии.

definition: relating to the design of buildings
sentence: The city is famous for its {architectural} treasures.
translation: Город славится своими архитектурными сокровищами.

definition: large heavy guns moved on wheels or tracks
sentence: The {artillery} fired at the hill for an hour before the attack.
translation: Артиллерия час обстреливала холм перед атакой.

definition: shaped like a circle, or going round and back to the start
sentence: The garden has a {circular} path around the fountain.
translation: В саду круговая дорожка вокруг фонтана.

definition: the movement of blood around the body, or of money, air or news
sentence: Exercise improves the {circulation} of blood to the brain.
translation: Упражнения улучшают кровообращение в мозге.

definition: the inner feeling that tells you whether what you do is right or wrong
sentence: His {conscience} would not let him keep the wallet he found.
translation: Совесть не позволила ему оставить найденный кошелёк.

definition: too many to be counted
sentence: She has told the story {countless} times.
translation: Она рассказывала эту историю бесчисленное количество раз.

definition: hard work and care given to something you believe in
sentence: Her {dedication} to the team never faded, even in defeat.
translation: Её преданность команде не угасала даже при поражении.

definition: being kept in a police station or prison, or kept after school as punishment
sentence: The suspect was held in {detention} for two days.
translation: Подозреваемого держали под стражей два дня.

definition: said or shown clearly, so nothing is left unclear
sentence: The teacher gave {explicit} instructions about the deadline.
translation: Учитель дал чёткие указания насчёт срока сдачи.

definition: in a clear and exact way
sentence: The contract {explicitly} forbids the sale of the data.
translation: Договор прямо запрещает продажу данных.

definition: an illness like a bad cold with a fever and aching body
sentence: Half the office is off with the {flu} this week.
translation: На этой неделе половина офиса болеет гриппом.

definition: soldiers who fight on foot
sentence: The {infantry} moved forward behind the tanks.
translation: Пехота двигалась вперёд за танками.

definition: necessary as part of a whole
sentence: Music is an {integral} part of every festival in the town.
translation: Музыка — неотъемлемая часть каждого праздника в городе.

definition: with little force or weight, or without serious thought
sentence: She touched his arm {lightly} to wake him.
translation: Она легонько коснулась его руки, чтобы разбудить.

definition: connected with the sea, ships or sailing
sentence: The museum tells the {maritime} history of the port.
translation: Музей рассказывает о морской истории порта.

definition: the box, paper or plastic that goods are wrapped in
sentence: The toy came in so much {packaging} that it filled the bin.
translation: Игрушка пришла в такой куче упаковки, что та заполнила всё ведро.

definition: relating to the areas around the North or South Pole
sentence: The {polar} ice is melting faster than scientists expected.
translation: Полярный лёд тает быстрее, чем ожидали учёные.

definition: famous and admired for something
sentence: The city is {renowned} for its fish market and its bridges.
translation: Город известен своим рыбным рынком и мостами.

definition: in a way that relates to society or to meeting people
sentence: They know each other {socially} but have never worked together.
translation: Они знакомы по общим компаниям, но никогда не работали вместе.

definition: by a large amount or degree
sentence: The new engine is {substantially} quieter than the old one.
translation: Новый двигатель существенно тише старого.

definition: of excellent quality, very good
sentence: The hotel served a {superb} breakfast with fresh fruit.
translation: В отеле подавали превосходный завтрак со свежими фруктами.
